name: Chrobox timeboxing completion dataset
description: Aggregated, anonymized task-completion figures from the Chrobox timeboxing app. Published as the primary source for the completion rates quoted on chrobox.net.
method: Production task records from signed-in accounts, tasks dated before the extraction day. Excludes calendar-imported events, operator/test accounts and deleted accounts. Aggregates only; groups under 30 tasks are not reported.
variablesMeasured: Task completion rate, time-boxed vs unscheduled tasks
Time box length distribution and completion by length
Completion rate by time box start time
Tasks planned per day and share of days fully completed
Completion rate by day of week
